title: XXIV: Conclusion

teacherSummary.text: Witnesses disagree: most saw a scarlet letter in the minister's flesh, but some saw nothing. Chillingworth withers and dies within a year, leaving his fortune to Pearl, who goes abroad and seems to marry happily. Hester returns years later, wears the letter by choice and counsels troubled women. She is buried near Dimmesdale under one tombstone.
